what: For each title line, the letters appear 50px below, tilted 3°, and rise straight over 1s. After 1s a highlighter band is painted behind that line from the left over .8s (easeInOutQuart) and stays. It turns on when the line reaches +50px below the screen bottom and turns off when it goes back below, repainting each time it passes.

options.on: ”load” turns it on as soon as it attaches, regardless of scroll (hero title), after delay seconds. Default scroll
options.delay: on: wait before turning on at load (seconds), default 0 — for deferring until the loader clears
options.replay: If ”off”, once turned on it never turns off. Default toggles each time, like the original
options.--fx-band-delay · --fx-band-dur: Wait before the band is painted · paint duration (via style), default 1s · .8s
options.--fx-rise-dur: Rise duration of characters (via style), default 1s
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One line to paint the band (several children). If absent, the element itself counts as one line
